bull_case: Buyers gain selection, delivery and payments; merchants gain demand, logistics, payments, ads and credit. Cross-product usage raises customer ROI and makes the ecosystem increasingly mission-critical.
bear_case: Free shipping and credit can subsidize growth, while merchants and consumers can multi-home. Strong usage does not guarantee attractive unit economics in every product.
thesis: Customer value is strong and broad. Rapid GMV and TPV growth at scale indicates repeated use, while MELI's integrated logistics, payments and credit solve real regional frictions. The main concern is unit economics: lower free-shipping thresholds and credit expansion are currently pressuring margin and adjusted FCF. Growth is not subsidy-only, but the incremental payback of current incentives must be demonstrated.

evidence.claim: H1 GMV grew 43% and TPV 53%, demonstrating strong customer usage across commerce and payments.
Fintech MAUs reached 78M in FY2025 while the platform remained a regional commerce leader.
Management reduced Brazil free-shipping thresholds and expanded credit, contributing to margin pressure.

counterevidence: Free shipping can transfer economics from shareholders to customers.
Credit losses can offset customer-engagement gains.
Merchants can multi-home across Amazon, Shopee and local channels.
unknowns: Cohort ROI from Brazil free-shipping changes.
Credit customer lifetime value after losses.

uncertainties.rationale: Usage scale and growth strongly evidence customer value.
Current growth investment is depressing margin and FCF.

falsifiers: Usage remains strong but unit economics deteriorate for multiple years.
Credit losses exceed incremental financial-income economics.
Shipping subsidies fail to produce durable cohort retention.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Large-scale GMV, TPV and fintech usage show real recurring utility; subsidies are an investment lever, not the sole source of demand.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: MELI spans commerce, logistics, payments, credit and ads across multiple countries; no single customer is existential.

subscores.rationale: The ecosystem solves multiple high-friction customer jobs.
Large-scale commerce and payment usage continue to accelerate.
Strong scale economics coexist with current investment-driven margin pressure.
